title: Hugo / HTTP API
description: REST traffic by route template, method, status, and tenant: rates, latency percentiles, top routes by p95, payload sizes, errors, and Watson listener metrics.

links.title: Logs in Loki
links.tooltip: Open matching log lines in Explore

list.name: job
list.label: Job
list.description: Prometheus scrape job of the Hugo server (hugo-server in Docker Compose).

list.name: window
list.label: Average over
list.description: Window for rates, averages, and percentiles. Agent and tool traffic is bursty, so short windows leave gaps.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: REST requests in the selected range.

targets.expr: round(sum(increase(hugo_http_requests_total{job=~"$job", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Requests per second
panels.description: Average REST request rate over the averaging window.

targets.expr: sum(rate(hugo_http_requests_total{job=~"$job", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant"}[$window])) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Server errors (5xx)
panels.description: Requests answered with a 5xx status in the selected range.

targets.expr: round(sum(increase(hugo_http_requests_total{job=~"$job", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant", status_class="5xx"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Error ratio
panels.description: Share of requests answered 5xx over the averaging window.

targets.expr: sum(rate(hugo_http_requests_total{job=~"$job", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant", status_class="5xx"}[$window])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(hugo_http_requests_total{job=~"$job", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant"}[$window])), 1e-9) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: In flight
panels.description: REST requests being handled right now, including long polls and streams (not filtered by route).

targets.expr: sum(hugo_http_requests_in_flight{job=~"$job"}) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Latency p95
panels.description: 95th percentile REST latency over the averaging window.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(hugo_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant"}[$window]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Requests by status class (per second)
panels.description: Request rate by status class. Requests the client abandoned are counted as aborted, never 5xx.

targets.expr: sum by (status_class) (rate(hugo_http_requests_total{job=~"$job", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "status_class", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Latency percentiles
panels.description: p50, p95, and p99 REST latency from the histogram buckets. Exemplars link to the request trace in Tempo.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(hugo_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant"}[$window]))) or on() vector(0)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(hugo_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant"}[$window]))) or on() vector(0)
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(hugo_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant"}[$window]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Requests by route (per second)
panels.description: Request rate of the ten busiest route templates.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (method, route) (rate(hugo_http_requests_total{job=~"$job", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Top routes by p95
panels.description: The ten route templates with the highest 95th percentile latency over the averaging window.

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, method, route) (rate(hugo_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant"}[$window]))))

panels.title: Client errors (4xx) by route
panels.description: 4xx responses per interval by route template (validation failures, authentication, not found).

targets.expr: sum by (method, route, status_code) (increase(hugo_http_requests_total{job=~"$job", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant", status_class="4xx"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "route", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Server errors (5xx) and aborts by route
panels.description: 5xx responses and client aborts (status 499) per interval by route template.

targets.expr: sum by (method, route, status_class) (increase(hugo_http_requests_total{job=~"$job", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant", status_class=~"5xx|aborted"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "route", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Requests by tenant (per second)
panels.description: Request rate by tenant (none for anonymous requests).

targets.expr: sum by (tenant) (rate(hugo_http_requests_total{job=~"$job", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "tenant", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Latency p95 by tenant
panels.description: 95th percentile REST latency by tenant.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, tenant) (rate(hugo_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant"}[$window])))

panels.title: Request body size p95 by route
panels.description: 95th percentile request body size by route template.

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, method, route) (rate(hugo_http_request_size_bytes_bucket{job=~"$job", route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[$window]))))

panels.title: Response body size p95 by route
panels.description: 95th percentile response body size by route template (0 for streamed responses).

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, method, route) (rate(hugo_http_response_size_bytes_bucket{job=~"$job", route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[$window]))))

panels.title: Routes
panels.description: Every route template that received traffic in the selected range: requests, 5xx share, and latency.

targets.expr: sum by (method, route) (increase(hugo_http_requests_total{job=~"$job", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant"}[$__range]))

sum by (method, route) (increase(hugo_http_requests_total{job=~"$job", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant", status_class="5xx"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum by (method, route) (increase(hugo_http_requests_total{job=~"$job", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant"}[$__range])), 1)
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, method, route) (rate(hugo_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, method, route) (rate(hugo_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, method, route) (rate(hugo_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", tenant=~"$tenant"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Watson request duration p95 by route
panels.description: 95th percentile from Watson's own http.server.request.duration (OpenTelemetry semantic conventions), by http_route. Covers every route Watson served, including /metrics and the MCP and A2A endpoints.

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, http_request_method, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job"}[$window]))))

panels.title: Active requests and connections
panels.description: Requests Watson is processing and TCP connections open on the listener.

targets.expr: sum(http_server_active_requests{job=~"$job"}) or on() vector(0)
sum(watson_server_connections_active{job=~"$job"}) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Listener throughput
panels.description: Bytes received and sent by the Watson listener per second.

targets.expr: sum(rate(watson_server_received_bytes_total{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() vector(0)
sum(rate(watson_server_sent_bytes_total{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() vector(0)
